correctness.rationale: The scale product has logarithm \(-3\log n\) plus a convergent error tail whose remaining tail is \(o(1/\log n)\). Integral comparison gives \(S_n=(C/2)n^{-2}(1+o(1/\log n))\); this yields the h-ratio expansion and conditioned drift \(-1/(2n)+o(1/(n\log n))\). The conditioned birth-death weights are \(n^{-1}\exp(o(\log\log n))\), hence not summable. The first-step recurrence contradicts a finite mean hitting time. The finite script is supplementary.
